page.overview:
What is Halloween Animatronics?

The Halloween animatronics are Halloween variants of mainly Nightmare Animatronics (and some other animatronics such as Daycare Attendant) from throughout the core series. First appearing in Five Nights at Freddy's 4: Halloween Edition.

They also returned in Ultimate Custom Night, Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted, Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery and Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2.

Most of the Halloween Animatronics are variants of the Nightmare Animatronics. They are based off Halloween themed characters and decorations, namely jack-o-lanterns, trick-or-treaters, and Frankenstein's Monster.

Unlike the Nightmare Animatronics, the Halloween Animatronics may not be hallucinations and instead characters made by Glitchtrap and Fazbear Entertainment for the VR Games. If this is true, it means that none of the Halloween Animatronics physically existed. In the games, however, they appear to function similarly to their pre-existing counterparts.
